amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Slider 0…1 = full-scale bipolar wave. Min/max are guides only — type large values for gain past unity (domain not hard-clamped).

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

curve.tooltip: Power-law after the one-pole (raw^Curve). 1 = linear; >1 digs in (vactrol gamma); <1 expands the middle.

cycle.tooltip: Off = one-shot (Trigger) or follow (Gate). Loop = auto-repeat AD. LFO = free-run AD; Gate rising edge hard-syncs.

decay.tooltip: Fall time constant. Same family as vactrol release / photoconductive lag.

attack.tooltip: Rise time constant. ~63% of the way toward peak in this time.

inputMode.tooltip: Gate = follow high/low (vactrol AR). Trigger = rising edge fires one Attack→Decay.

polarity.tooltip: Unipolar Bias 0…Max. Bipolar Bias −Max…+Max (thru-zero capable sources).

rangeMax.tooltip: Bias range extent in domain units. Unipolar: 0…Max. Bipolar: −Max…+Max. Wire Bias into Freq (base 0) for absolute control.
